evals.name: Trigger - Build a thin affected adapter
evals.prompt: This two-package repository has real npm checks but no stable agent-facing command. Add quick, affected, and full feedback; local affected must include staged, unstaged, and untracked files.
evals.expected_output: A thin adapter delegating to native commands with explicit change discovery, conservative mapping, and compact truthful results.
expectations: Delegates instead of copying native lint, type, test, and build definitions
Includes staged, unstaged, and untracked local paths
Widening covers shared configuration and known reverse dependents
Invalid modes and required command failures remain nonzero

evals.name: Workflow - Native graph, path escape, and unknown fallback
evals.prompt: Expose the monorepo's native affected command. Explicit scopes may be passed from nested directories; reject paths outside the repository and widen unknown or deleted paths safely.
evals.expected_output: Native affected delegation with normalized in-repository scopes, repository-escape rejection, rename/delete handling, and a broader fallback.
expectations: Resolves explicit paths from the documented caller directory
Rejects repository escapes before mapping or dispatch
Preserves deleted paths and maps both sides of renames when relevant
Leaves unrelated dirty files untouched and never uses eval on path data

evals.name: Rerun - Preserve a sufficient native interface
evals.prompt: Run harness-verify again after no native command, CI, topology, or safety change. The existing Make targets already expose all three modes.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-backed no-op with no wrapper or semantic diff.
expectations: Does not add init.sh or one-command helper files
Does not run full mechanically or claim unrun checks passed

evals.name: No trigger - Run an already clear targeted test
evals.prompt: Run the documented unit test for src/parser.ts after my focused fix; verification design is already clear.
evals.expected_output: harness-verify should not trigger merely to execute an existing check.
expectations: Creates or redesigns no verification artifact
Does not broaden the request into CI or garden work
